sources.title: quettaset/H36 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Severe Electromigration & Voiding: Extreme current densities dislodge copper atoms, creating critical structural degradation. Grain Boundary Scattering: Narrow wiring dimensions cause chaotic electron scattering, drastically increasing electrical resistance and heat buildup.
